quarterly_data.signal: Applied's 10-K segment table: Semiconductor Systems net revenue was $20,798 million in fiscal 2025 versus $19,911 million in fiscal 2024 and $19,698 million in fiscal 2023, and Applied Global Services net revenue was $6,385 million versus $6,225 million and $5,732 million. Foundry, logic and other was 67% of Semiconductor Systems revenue by customer market in fiscal 2025 (68% in 2024, 77% in 2023); foundry and logic spending rose in fiscal 2025 driven primarily by higher customer investments in leading-edge manufacturing technologies.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor Systems $20,798 million (fiscal 2025) vs $19,911 million (fiscal 2024); Applied Global Services $6,385 million vs $6,225 million; foundry, logic and other 67% of Semiconductor Systems revenue (68% in fiscal 2024)

quarterly_data.signal: Applied manufactures systems to meet demand represented by order backlog and customer commitments; of the total backlog as of October 26, 2025, approximately 31% is not reasonably expected to be filled within the next 12 months.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 31% of backlog as of October 26, 2025 not expected to be filled within 12 months

players.product: deposition/etch/CMP tools and TSV via formation equipment

quarterly_data.signal: DRAM was 26% of Applied's Semiconductor Systems revenue by customer market in fiscal 2025, versus 28% in fiscal 2024 and 17% in fiscal 2023. The 10-K says semiconductor equipment investment is expected to remain strong with growth in the adoption of high-bandwidth memory and other forms of advanced packaging and continued demand for AI and data center computing.
quarterly_data.figure: DRAM 26% of Semiconductor Systems revenue (fiscal 2025) vs 28% (fiscal 2024) and 17% (fiscal 2023)

players.product: high-aspect-ratio etch/deposition & ALD tools for 3D NAND channel holes

quarterly_data.signal: Flash memory (NAND) was 7% of Applied's Semiconductor Systems revenue by customer market in fiscal 2025, versus 4% in fiscal 2024 and 6% in fiscal 2023; memory customers' spending in fiscal 2025 was higher due to increased customer investments in NAND fabrication equipment upgrades.
